# Skip's Barbershop

> Skip's Barbershop is a barbershop with three locations: South Boston (Southie) and the South End in Boston, Massachusetts, and Providence, Rhode Island. It started in South Boston in 1906 and was run by Skip Scaro, then by his son and his grandson; Anthony Costa runs it today. Some listings still call the South Boston shop Skip Scaro's Barber Shop. Appointments are booked online through Squire, and walk-ins are welcome.

Skip's Barbershop is your local Barbershop with a comfortable and welcoming feel and high-end execution and attention to detail

## Locations

- [South Boston](https://www.skipsbarbershop.com/south-boston): 78 Dorchester St, Boston, MA 02127. Phone +1 (617) 269-2227. Monday to Friday 10 AM - 7 PM, Saturday 9 AM - 4 PM, Sunday closed. Nearest T stop: Andrew station. Street parking. [Book South Boston](https://web.getsquire.com/book/skips-barbershop-south-boston-boston)
- [South End](https://www.skipsbarbershop.com/south-end): 603 Tremont St, Boston, MA 02118. Phone +1 (617) 982-7981. Monday 10:30 AM - 7 PM, Tuesday to Thursday 10 AM - 8 PM, Friday 7:30 AM - 8 PM, Saturday 9:30 AM - 6 PM, Sunday closed. Nearest train station: Back Bay. Street parking. [Book South End](https://web.getsquire.com/book/skips-barbershop-south-end-boston)
- [Providence](https://www.skipsbarbershop.com/providence): 556 Atwells Ave, Providence, RI 02909, at the bottom of Federal Hill. Phone +1 (401) 308-7547. Monday 8 AM - 5 PM, Tuesday 9 AM - 7:30 PM, Wednesday and Thursday 9 AM - 6:30 PM, Friday 9 AM - 6 PM, Saturday and Sunday 8 AM - 5 PM. Street parking. Wheelchair accessible. [Book Providence](https://web.getsquire.com/book/skips-barbershop-providence-providence)

## What we do

- Walk-ins: yes. Same-day appointments are possible.
- Fades and tapers (skin, low, mid and high) and lineups.
- Hot towel shaves, head shaves and face shaves.
- Beard trims, which can be booked on their own.
- Kids' haircuts.
- Curly and textured hair.
- Longer hair and all-scissor cuts.
- Executive Service (90 minutes), including hot towel and steam.
- Group and wedding events, called Whiskey and Whiskers.
- Gift cards are sold online.

## Prices in South Boston and the South End

- Classic Cut $56
- Buzz Cut / Kids / Senior $41
- Scissors Cut $77
- Beard Trim (No Shave) $47
- Classic Cut + Beard Trim $78
- Deluxe Cut + Beard (with Shave) $100
- Deluxe Cut + Face Shave $100
- Executive Service (90 mins) $150

## Good to know

- Payment: cash, card, Apple Pay or Venmo.
- Cancellation: four-hour cancellation policy.
- Languages: mostly English, and some Spanish.
- Products: Church California is the number one product on the shelf.
